channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Relief for Gajularamaram Residents as HYDRAA Assures Safety of Homes, Orders Alternate Sites for Pragathi Nagar Vendors
item.description: HYDRAA assures protection of poor families’ homes at Gajularamaram Survey No. 307 and orders alternative sites for vendors near Pragathi Nagar Cheruvu during a field inspection.

item.title: Dholpur Rape Case, Ex-Cop Arrested Disguised as Woman, Booked Under POCSO Act
item.description: A suspended former police constable accused of raping a 16-year-old girl in Rajasthan has been arrested after he allegedly disguised himself as a woman to evade police.

item.title: Sara Tendulkar Goa Video Goes Viral, Social Media Divided Over Bottle Speculation
item.description: A Goa video of Sara Tendulkar has gone viral, sparking online debate over a bottle seen in her hand. Social media remains divided amid speculation and support.

item.title: CM Revanth Reddy and BRS Supremo KCR Greet Telangana on New Year
item.description: BRS chief K Chandrashekar Rao extends New Year greetings to Telangana, reaffirming opposition role, while CM Revanth Reddy expresses hope for Telangana Rising Vision 2047.

item.title: Israeli military claims about 20,900 attacks in Middle East in 2025
item.description: Israel continued multi-front fighting throughout the year, necessitating the mobilisation of additional troops. The military called up about 306,830 reservists, including 54,000 who had previously been exempt from service, according to figures it released at the end of the year.

item.title: New Year begins on a wet note for Mumbaikars, unexpected rain drenches parts of city
item.description: The New Year 2026 began on a wet note for Mumbaikars as several parts of the country's financial capital witnessed rain early Thursday morning, altering the usual festive atmosphere associated with the first day of the year.

item.title: Tamil Nadu steps up vigil along Kerala border amid rising bird flu cases
item.description: With a rise in avian influenza cases reported in parts of Kerala, including Alappuzha and Kottayam, authorities in Tamil Nadu have intensified surveillance along the border districts to prevent the disease from spreading into the state.

item.title: Dense fog disrupts flights across North India; airlines issue advisory
item.description: Flight operations across several parts of northern and eastern India, including Delhi, were affected on Thursday as dense fog engulfed large swathes of the region, sharply reducing visibility and prompting airlines to issue advisories for passengers.

item.title: Karnataka gang-rape case: Taluq health officer booked for destroying evidence
item.description: According to the police, although the accused in the gang-rape case were arrested within a few hours of the incident, the role of Yalaburga taluk health officer Dr Shivakumar in allegedly protecting the accused has come to light during the investigation.

item.title: Chiranjeevi, Kamal Haasan, Allu Arjun express heartfelt wishes to fans on new year!
item.description: Actor, producer and parliamentarian Kamal Haasan on Thursday wished his fans and followers on social media a happy new year, even as he pointed out to them that the new year presented another chance for one to become "better, kinder and wiser" than the year before.
